title: Semiorthogonal decompositions for stacks
summary: We give a systematic construction of semiorthogonal decompositions of derived categories of coherent sheaves on quasi-smooth derived algebraic stacks over $\mathbb{C}$, where the summands are subcategories defined by weight conditions, and the inclusion functors are given by parabolic induction. The summands are indexed by the component lattice of the stack, a central combinatorial structure in intrinsic Donaldson-Thomas theory.
